snippet.title: Mecha Tower Defense - Long Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
This isn't your grandma's tower defense. Evolve towers, level characters, complete achievements and earn account-wide points. With every success and failure your power will grow. Find the tower evolution that will synergize with your overall strategy and allow you to succeed!

Mecha Tower Defense is a new Roguelite Tower Defense game. Demo out today on Steam! 

Please consider Wishlisting on Steam if you are interested!
